title: Figures 7-8: vacuum energy density minima vs. extra-dimension radius; false vacuum minima
description: Two line plots of vacuum energy density (y-axis) versus radius of the extra dimension (x-axis), in normalized units. Figure 7 shows several dashed component field curves (legend includes Higgs, lepton/quark, fermionic and scalar Casimir fields) combining into a solid curve with a stable minimum. Figure 8, "False Vacuum Minima are Created Around a Spacecraft", shows three curves labeled "Artifical minimum", "Natural minimum" and "Artifical minimum".
